_source_note: 60 glaze recipes from Chapter 11 of Richard Zakin's 'Electric Kiln Ceramics: A Guide to Clays and Glazes' (3rd ed, Krause/F+W Media, 2004) - ingredient/percentage data, with surface and colour descriptions written in our own words from the facts Zakin reports. All recipes in this chapter are written for oxidation firing in an electric kiln, which is why the book exists. Generic material terms (boron frit, soda frit, potash feldspar, red clay, stoneware clay) are Zakin's own category names, not specific branded products - most are left unresolved rather than guessed at, except where this database already defaults a generic term to a standard equivalent (Potash Feldspar -> Custer Feldspar, Soda Feldspar -> Minspar 200, Iron/Iron Oxide -> Red Iron Oxide, Zirconium/Zirconium Opacifier -> Zircopax). Two recipes (Dewitt Mills, Franklin R 92) sum to 88% and 80% respectively as printed in the book - confirmed against the source text, not a transcription gap; kept faithful to the original rather than padded to 100. The Estacada recipe (cone 3) uses 'potash' and 'spodium' in the original where every neighboring recipe spells out 'potash feldspar' and 'spodumene' - treated as the book's own abbreviation/typo and resolved accordingly, noted per-recipe. Surface labels were inferred from Zakin's own prose descriptions and carry surface_source='description'; he states the fired surface for most glazes but not as a separate field. Five have no surface claim in the text and are deliberately left unlabelled rather than guessed.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Opaque 04 k2
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: A basic opaque low-fire glaze base of boron frit, talc, ball clay, and zirconium opacifier.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: 04 Clear k2
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: A basic transparent low-fire glaze base of boron frit, talc, and ball clay.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Robin's 1b Clear k2
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: A transparent low-fire glaze base built on spodumene and boron frit 3124, with talc and ball clay.
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.notes: 'boron frit 3124' as printed -> resolved to Frit 3124

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Mohawk Green F k2
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Low in silica and high in alumina and flux, fluxed mainly by soda, calcium, boron and lithium. Saturated green with noticeable texture.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Millbrook Visitor
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Glossy, transparent and hard-wearing.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Tottman
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Dry matte. Yellow thick, rust thin, heavily textured; iron from the red clay.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Cobblestone Base
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin-gloss ivory.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Lorraine Earth Yellow
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin-gloss. Soft yellow thick, tan thin; red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Wardwell Brown
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte brown leaning persimmon, with fine ochre spotting. Iron from both clays.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Towle Gulf Yellow
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Matte. Mustard yellow thick, rust-red thin; red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: 02 Millennium MetalBlack
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Midnight black, from Barnard clay iron and manganese plus cobalt. Plain on its own, but tends to bring out texture in glazes layered with it.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: 02 Orange Chartreuse
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Matte. Chartreuse thick, rust thin; colour from the red clay.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: 02 Dark Matte
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte. Dark mustard thick, red-brown thin; red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Tremaines Persimmon
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Glossy and fluid - pulls back from edges. Cream thick, brown thin; iron from both clays.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Millbrook Opaque 2
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Smooth, glossy opaque white.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Millbrook Opaque 3
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Glossy opaque white.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Cadwells Base
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Dry matte, opaque, muted blue-green.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Dewitt Mills
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque satin matte, cream to tan - cream when applied thick. Pleasant to handle and strongly textured.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Dewitt White 1
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Soft opaque satin matte in a slightly greyed ivory; the grey comes from the stoneware clay.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Fulton 4a Deep Blue
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque waxy matte. Grey thin, deep slate blue thick. Heavy in strontium, so watch for settling in the bucket.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Oz Strontium IV
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque velvety matte, strong green. Strontium gives a barium-like matte without barium's toxicity, though it can settle.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Richmond Mills
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque satin matte, cream thick, pale amber thin. Durable - a good liner candidate.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Snyders 2
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque satin-gloss, silver-grey to ochre with visible texture. Iron from the oxide and the stoneware clay. Hard-wearing.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Sodus Point 2
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque matte, yellow-ochre to brown, coloured by the Barnard and stoneware clays.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Orwell Amber
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin. Butterscotch thick, amber-brown thin; iron from both clays, plus titania from the stoneware.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Wardwell Persimmon
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Stony satin matte in a soft persimmon-brown, mostly from stoneware and red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Dutcherville Barn Red
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin-gloss, bright iron red from the red clay.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Minoa Amber
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin-gloss. Tan thick, red-amber thin; iron from both clays. Tin noticeably improves both colour and surface.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Fairdale Bridge
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte, very pale yellow. The rutile works as flux and colourant at once.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Dewitt Dark Tan 3
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte in a mottled range of browns, coloured by Barnard clay iron and manganese.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Stone Hill
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin, creamy tan, with texture following application thickness. Red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Checkered House Ocher
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Matte, soft earth yellow. Iron from the rutile and the stoneware clay.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Howardville
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte. Earth yellow thick, amber thin, texture shifting strongly with thickness. Iron from both clays.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Bethel Gray
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Hard-wearing satin matte. Grey-mustard thick, orange-brown thin, sometimes flecked dark brown. Iron and titania from both clays.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Canton Brown
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte, ochre to brown. Red-clay iron plus the cobalt addition.
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.notes: 1.5% cobalt carbonate - ocher and brown; 2.5% cobalt - rich matte black

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Estacada
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Matte. Warm yellow thick, orange-tan thin, lightly speckled and earthy. Iron from both clays.
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.notes: 'potash' as printed -> resolved to Potash Feldspar; 'spodium' as printed -> resolved to Spodumene

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: C/3 Millennium MetalBlack
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Grainy, high-shine metallic ebony black from Barnard clay iron and manganese; 1% cobalt deepens it to midnight black. Little texture alone, but brings it out in layered glazes.
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.notes: 'boron frit (3124)' as printed -> resolved to Frit 3124

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Denton
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque satin-gloss, cool green.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Soft Tan Base
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque matte, warm ivory.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Satin White
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque satin matte, silvery white.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Transparent Matte Glaze
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte yet translucent - an unusual pairing, and a style common in American work from the 1900s to the 1930s.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: MetalBlack
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte metallic black, from a heavy Barnard clay load plus copper.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Corinth Corners
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Glossy opaque, deep grey-mustard with rust showing at thin edges. A very heavy red-clay load supplies the iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Estacada 18
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte. Amber-brown thick, bleached mustard thin; red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Estacada Gray-Ocher
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Glossy. Soft cream thick, light burnt orange thin; red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Estacada Orange-Ocher
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Glossy. Soft cream thick, burnt orange thin, with texture tracking thickness. Red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Barnard Estacada
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Glossy deep red umber; can pull away from thin edges. Colour from Barnard clay iron and manganese.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Maple View Cream-Orange
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte. Orange thick, pale cream-orange thin, texture tracking thickness. Red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Sayles Corners
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte. Light mustard thick, light orange thin; red-clay iron.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Crawling Vitgobe
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Vitreous engobe that bubbles and wrinkles into a complex surface, cream-tan; colour and texture both come from its heavy stoneware clay content.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Mullen Hill Base
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Smooth eggshell matte, oyster white. With 2% copper carbonate it moves through amber and brown to green.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Vans White
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin-gloss white.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Ridgebury
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin-gloss, transparent, iron green to orange.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Franklin R 92
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin, red-brown to burnt umber, strongly textured by its calcium and magnesium.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Gateville R 92
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Translucent satin, ochre through amber to dark brown, strongly textured by lithium, calcium/magnesium and titania.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: H GK 92
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque bone white; the surface runs from stony and dry to pitted.
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.notes: 'zirconium' as printed -> resolved to Zirconium Opacifier

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Harpersfield R 92
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque satin red-brown. Unstable, and bubbles when applied thick.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Deerpark Base
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Satin matte, amber-cream to amber, strongly textured by its iron and calcium/magnesium.

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Pilgrim Vitreous Engobe 92
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque semi-vitreous white with a faint sheen.
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.notes: 'zirconium' as printed -> resolved to Zirconium Opacifier

zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.name: Woodbourne Base 92
zakin_electric_kiln_glazes.description: Opaque satin matte, amber-yellow.
